fine_trace.note: The input-controlled SSML tag text is passed from the clause reader into the SSML implementation.
For the input <mark name=...> tag, the mark name copied from the attribute is stored in the shared namedata buffer and an embedded mark command carries its offset.

AddNameData may move or free the previous namedata allocation while offsets and later event pointers still refer to data in that allocation; existing event name storage must remain valid until event consumption.

When the embedded mark event is emitted, the event stores a raw pointer into namedata; if that allocation has been moved or freed, reading the mark name through ep->id.name becomes a heap-use-after-free read.
